references.text: In the corresponding account in Matthew, the disciples react in the same way as Philip, suggesting that people be sent away to buy food because they believe there is not enough to feed them.
Mark's version of the event also includes the disciples' concern about the cost of buying bread, with a stated amount equivalent to 200 denarii, just as in John.

Luke reports that the disciples say they have no more than five loaves and two fish, and that this is not enough for so many, reflecting Philip's conclusion that there is not enough bread for each person to receive even a small portion.
